name: Griffon Corporation
summary: Griffon Corporation, through its subsidiaries, provides home and building, and consumer and professional products in the United States, Canada, Australia, and internationally. The Building Products segment manufactures and markets residential and sectional commercial garage doors, rolling steel service doors, fire doors, shutters, steel security grilles, and room dividers. It also provides residential, industrial, and commercial ceiling fans under Hunter, Casablanca, and Jan Fan brands. The company also sells garage door openers.
